newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Leningrad region mulls Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Leningrad region mulls Eurobond issue.

text.p: Russia's north-western Leningrad region plans to launch Eurobonds and several types of domestic bonds, the regional administration's press service said on Friday.
Four types of paper would be launched -- Eurobonds, domestic short-term bonds, savings bonds for private individuals and housing bonds, according to an administration securities plan.
No issue date was set. The savings bond issue plan must be ready for presentation to the finance ministry by April 1, it said.

Several Russian regions and cities, including Moscow, Nizhny Novgorod and St Petersburg, plan to issue Eurobonds, but the issues have been delayed because the relevant Russian legislation is not clear.
The government is drawing up regulations on taxation and other items for regions issuing or planning to launch Eurobonds.
The city of St Petersburg is in the Leningrad region and is its capital, but the region has a different administration and budget.
